Data:Slnev.zachary.ehsan.json.startdescription: Zachary speaks to Ehsan of the stairway to Nowhere which haunts his paintings, of the lamps of black nephrite, the star-twinkle of the flowers in Miss Naenia's hair. There is more than one temptation to Nowhere, he says… [Lesson: Sights & Sensations]

Data:Slnev.zachary.fraser.json.startdescription: Fraser suggests ways in which Zachary might advance or evolve his limbless passengers so that they might both become something more - in safety. Zachary is not convinced. [Lesson: Serpents & Venoms]

Data:Slnev.zachary.hokobald.json.startdescription: Zachary and Hokobald discuss the Sun's division, which Zachary suspects is an outcome of 'a conspiracy of heaven', and Hokobald insists was 'the Great Work of Destiny'. [Lesson: The Great Signs and the Great Scars]

Data:Slnev.zachary.morgen.json.startdescription: Zachary asks Morgen frankly about esoteric techniques to contain appetite in an external vessel. Morgen retorts haughtily that she's never felt any need to contain her appetites, externally or otherwise - but over the course of her conversation, she clearly develops a degree of sympathy for the pale, twitching once-detective. [Lesson: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]

Data:Slnev.zachary.olympe.json.startdescription: 'I have a name', Zachary says dispassionately, 'and another name. One of them is written only in Killasimi. I will speak of it, because you have invited me. But I will not speak it, because I am a guest.' [Lesson: Killasimi]

Data:Slnev.zachary.serena.json.startdescription: Serena offers to shape a prison for Zachary and his passenger if things become too dire. He will consider it; he wryly shares his thoughts on what might contain him. [Lesson: Glassblowing & Vesselcrafting]

Data:Slnev.zachary.stanislav.json.startdescription: Stanislav advises Zachary on 'words of mercy', which might quell the urgencies that trouble Zachary's skin. 'I know that one!' Zachary says suddenly. 'It descends from Chione.' [Lesson: Quenchings & Quellings]

Data:Slnev.zachary.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Denzil and Zachary speak more of their old acquaintance from the time when Zachary was recovering in Brancrug after the Great War. They recall those they both knew at Hush House: Hattington ('in a New York madhouse, I think'), Illopoly ('in Marseilles, I think') and Collers ('dead, I hope')… [Lesson: Ragged Crossroads]

Data:Slnev.zachary.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Zachary asks if Mr Kille might make a coffin for him. 'I don't need it yet,' he says, 'but we all might be grateful.' Mr Kille shakes his head slowly: not his kind of work. But he suggests that Zachary speak of his troubles, and Zachary does so, albeit elliptically, in terms of mirrors; snow; wings; and the 'twist in the heart'. [Lesson: Snow Stories]

Data:Slnev.zachary.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy, who perhaps has gleaned something of the nature of Zachary's condition - or perhaps only thought he  has gleaned it - offers Zachary prayers and meditative exercises that he believes might help. Zachary repeats them back to him without any change in expression. [Lesson: Quenchings & Quellings]

Data:Slnev.zachary.yvette.json.startdescription: 'It is cold,' Zachary whispers to Yvette. He shivers. 'I must stay cold, mustn't I? If I thaw, I will come loose, won't I?' Yvette nods carefully. 'I think it's for the best that you don't thaw - not yet - ' she agrees. [Lesson: Snow Stories]

Data:Slnrsp.coquille.pie.pumpkin.honey.j.startdescription: Coquille smilingly samples the cuckoo-honey-dosed pumpkin pie. 'Coucou,' she coos, eyes half-closed. 'I have always enjoyed the work of the Blomberende-kind.' Sleepily, she tells the startling story of her seduction of a scion of the House of Scudamore - 'one toothsome enough that I enjoyed his company, but not so tempting that I might regret it when the time came to press him out of their lovely nest...' [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnrsp.coquille.soup.pumpkin.honey..startdescription: Coquille smilingly samples the cuckoo-honey-dosed pumpkin soup. 'Coucou,' she coos, eyes half-closed. 'I have always enjoyed the work of the Blomberende-kind.' Sleepily, she tells the startling story of her seduction of a scion of the House of Scudamore - 'one toothsome enough that I enjoyed his company, but not so tempting that I might regret it when the time came to press him out of their lovely nest...' [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnrsp.ehsan.pie.pilchards.json.startdescription: 'Starygazy pie?' Ehsan exclaims. He snaffles a slice. 'Brancrug at its best. I've been going to the Sweet Bones for this since… well, longer than I care to remember. The stories the fishermen tell...' [Lesson: Sea Stories]

Data:Slnrsp.visiting.killes.beverage.rav.startdescription: With clear caution, Mrs Kille samples the wine - red wine from the bottle with the Domaine Raveline label. As the taste crosses her tongue, her usual melancholy melts, and she smiles; but then she locks the smile away. 'I left all that behind,' she says. Her Cornish accent has blurred, like tempera in rain, so that another accent beneath it has become visible - something no warmer, but more quicksilver. 'I left all that behind before the qualities in the soil could enter my bones. Though all of us carry a little of it. And so I will never have children of my own. You understand, my darling' - she is speaking to Mr Kille - 'you understand, don't you? And you understand that I will take the small risk' - still to Mr Kille - 'of finishing this glass.' [Lesson: Stone Stories]

Data:Slnrsp.zachary.onion.gratin.json.startdescription: Zachary sits suddenly upright, staring at the dish of onion au gratin before him. 'We used to get this in the infirmary,' he says to no one in particular. 'When I came back from the War. I used to call it trojan cheese..' He takes a cautious bite; then another. 'I still don't like it,' he confides. His face is typically expressionless, but tears trickle down his cheeks. He begins to talk about the War... [Lesson: Disciplines of the Scar]
